title: Review Design of Laundry Pole-holders in HDB Blocks to Make Them Safer for Elderly
what_it_is: Review Design of Laundry Pole-holders in HDB Blocks to Make Them Safer for Elderly

sections.label: External clothes drying racks for new flats
sections.summary: Since 2002, new flats have been fitted with an external three-bar clothes drying rack parallel to the kitchen wall.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since 2002, new flats have been fitted with an external three-bar clothes drying rack parallel to the kitchen wall.

sections.label: HDB replacing pipe sockets with T-shaped racks
sections.summary: Through HIP, HDB has been replacing pipe sockets in older flats with T-shaped clothes drying racks that support both ends of laundry poles, reducing effort and minimising falling risk.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Through the Home Improvement Programme (HIP), HDB has been progressively replacing these pipe sockets that you find in older flats with T-shaped clothes drying racks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These T-shaped racks are designed to support both ends of the laundry poles, so that this reduces the effort required to place the laundry poles onto the racks and minimises the risk of the poles falling even under strong wind conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will continue to review the design of clothes drying racks to make them safer and easier for residents to use.
